draft.text: You came in because you wanted to talk about your recent blood tests and how you're feeling.
We found that your recent blood tests are still waiting for results.
You have psoriatic arthritis, which is being managed with medication.
We will schedule an appointment for more blood work to check your treatment.
We will also work on reducing your prednisone use.
We will follow up once your test results are ready.

unverified_summary.text: You came in because you have psoriatic arthritis and wanted to talk about your joint pain and stiffness.
You are managing your condition with methotrexate and prednisone.
You took extra prednisone for a few days because your foot pain got worse.
Your symptoms are likely related to your psoriatic arthritis.
The bruising you are getting may be from the prednisone.
We will do blood work to check how well your methotrexate is working and if it is safe.
We will also work on helping you stop using prednisone.
We will follow up once the blood work results are in.
